body.statement: Using the rank-stratified handle in \(\mathrm{def{:}boundary\text{-}handle}\), can one construct a joint-set estimator and confidence procedure that is Hausdorff consistent and uniformly covers \(\Theta_v(P^{(n)})\) along all positive-cell attainable sequences \((P^{(n)},c_n)\to(P,1)\), including relative-boundary limits at which Hankel ranks or endpoint attainment change? If full uniformity is impossible, characterize the maximal collection of adjacent rank strata on which it holds and exhibit a least-favorable sequence outside that collection.
body.justification: The unresolved content is the behavior of exact sharp endpoints when both the observable map and moment faces change rank.
body.gap: Generic set inference, the model-specific regular SDP procedure, and tractable outer bounds do not settle uniform exact-set inference through this rank change.
body.consumer: A confidence region for a slope near zero or a positive but boundary-attainable PSID law requires precisely this result.

obligation.what_is_open: A theorem giving a single joint-set estimator and confidence procedure with uniform Hausdorff consistency and coverage over positive-cell sequences approaching slope odds one, together with the maximal admissible collection of adjacent rank strata and a least-favorable sequence outside it.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen handle names rank stratification but supplies neither the stratum-wise tangent feasible correspondences nor a formal uniformity metric and confidence-level requirement. The proved observable-map rank jump from sixteen to fourteen changes the affine hull at slope odds one, while relative-interior convex continuity gives no control when Hankel rank or endpoint attainment changes.
obligation.attempted: The coefficient map was rank-stratified at slope odds one, the two new left-null restrictions were identified, and convex value-function continuity was applied on fixed-slope relative interiors. These arguments do not bound directional endpoint moduli on adjacent boundary faces and therefore cannot certify full uniformity or construct the requested least-favorable sequence.
obligation.partial_result:
For each fixed \(c>0\), fixed \(v\in\{\mathrm w,+\}\), and
\(P\in\operatorname{ri}(C_c^v)\), the projected plug-in endpoints are almost
surely consistent.  At \(c=1\), every nonempty APE fiber is \(\{0\}\), while
the observed-moment coefficient rank is fourteen rather than the rank sixteen
holding at \(c\ne1\).  Thus the affine hull used by the fixed-slope projection
changes at \(c=1\); no boundary-uniform conclusion follows from
relative-interior continuity.
